design_philosophy: Professional, premium, export-ready. A hyper-clean aesthetic that builds absolute trust with foreign B2B buyers (like Singapore), combining fresh organic greens with industrial precision and hygiene. Avoid generic template looks. Emphasize manufacturing scale, zero-chemical processes, and heritage.

typography.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-bold leading-none text-[#0F1A12]
typography.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight font-semibold leading-tight text-[#0F1A12]
typography.label: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#1E5631]
typography.font_install_instructions: Import 'Outfit' and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use The Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: Tetris Grid) for Capabilities and Features. Asymmetric bento grids to highlight scale, trucks, and cold storage alongside stats.
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-md (2px to 6px) to maintain a B2B industrial precision feel.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: shadow-sm for subtle lift, avoid heavy drop shadows. Use 1px borders (#DCE6DF) to define edges crisply.

components.buttons: Flat background with 1px subtle border. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and darken background. Primary CTA in #1E5631 text-white. Secondary CTA in transparent background, border-#1E5631, text-#1E5631.
components.cards: Solid #FFFFFF background, 1px border (#DCE6DF), no heavy shadows. Strict optical alignment.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFDF9]/80) with 1px bottom border (#DCE6DF). Must have visible navigation links on desktop, avoid hamburger menu on desktop.
components.forms: Strictly use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Select components. Customize border to #DCE6DF. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#1E5631]/20 border-[#1E5631]. Must include attributes like data-testid='b2b-inquiry-form'.

motion.scroll_effects: Use lenis for smooth scrolling if possible. Subtle fade-in-up (framer-motion) for bento grid children.

image_urls.description: Vibrant green peas in a bowl - use for the main hero overlay or product showcase to highlight natural green/no chemical.
Clean stainless steel factory interior - use in the 'Manufacturing & Quality Standards' section.
White refrigerated semi-truck on the road - use to represent the 18-21 tonne reefer supply capability.
Macro shot of green peas - use for blanch test/quality assurance section.

media.icons: Use lucide-react for UI icons (Chevron, Mail, Phone, MapPin, CheckCircle).

photography_guide.description: This is a custom photography brief for Mr. Frozen to replace placeholder images with actual high-end brand assets. Provide this to your professional photographer.

shot_list.subject: The Blanch Test & Raw Material
shot_list.instructions: Macro/close-up shots of the A-grade peas directly after blanching. Ensure lighting highlights the natural green color without looking artificial. Emphasize 'No ice padding' by showing dry, perfectly frozen IQF products.

shot_list.subject: Factory Cleanliness & Manufacturing
shot_list.instructions: Wide, well-lit architectural shots of the stainless steel machinery and cold storage rooms. Include staff wearing full PPE (hairnets, gloves, coats) interacting with the production line to visually prove hygiene standards.

shot_list.subject: Logistics & Scale
shot_list.instructions: Drone or wide-angle shots of the 18-21 tonne reefer trucks parked at the loading docks. Action shots of the 6-tonne distributor trucks being loaded.

shot_list.subject: 15% Protein Soya Chaap
shot_list.instructions: Food-styling studio shots of the raw Soya Chaap highlighting its soft texture, perhaps being sliced or pulled apart slightly to show the high-protein matrix. Place alongside fresh ingredients.

shot_list.subject: Heritage & Trust Signals
shot_list.instructions: A professional portrait of the founders/team inside the 35-year-old cold storage facility. High-resolution shot of the Amar Ujala award.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a professional, export-ready B2B marketing site. No purple/teal gradients. Use #FDFDF9 base and #1E5631 primary.
Implement a sticky header with standard nav links (About, Products, Quality, Export, Contact).
Hero Section: High-impact layout. Headline should focus on 'Premium IQF Vegetables & High-Protein Soya Chaap' targeting foreign B2B buyers.
Products Section: Showcase Peas, Carrots, Cauliflower, Soya Chaap, Cheese, Fries, Tikkis. Use grid or bento layout.
Quality Standards: Emphasize the Blanch Test, naturally green, no chemicals, no ice padding.
Capabilities & Logistics: Detail the 18-21 tonne reefer trucks, 6 tonne distributor delivery, 35-year heritage, and contract packaging.
Trust & Export Readiness: Highlight the Amar Ujala award and Moti Mahal client.

Include a 'Photography Guide' section on the site (perhaps hidden from public but accessible to admins, or presented as a dedicated module in the output for the client to read) - actually just present the guide nicely to the user in the completion summary.

Inquiry Form: Create a B2B contact form (Name, Company, Country, Product Interest, Quantity, Message) utilizing Shadcn. Store in DB (mocked or actual if backend is set up). Provide clear contact info (Email, Phone, WhatsApp).
